newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sows more maize, raises farming subsidy.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sows more maize, raises farming subsidy.

text.p: Croatia will increase its 1997 subsidies for agriculture by some 12 percent, state radio reported on Monday.
The radio quoted Agriculture Minister Matej Jankovic as saying this year's subsidies of 510 million kuna will be raised to 570 million in 1997.

Jankovic said Croatia's autumn-sown maize area, for the 1997 harvest, was 22.3 percent larger than last year. He said the 1996 maize crop, which yielded a surplus of between 300,000 and 400,000 tonnes, was excellent.
He did not give figures for the total crop but said some 100,000 tonnes of the maize surplus would be exported. --Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
